With ``subscription_id`` the event is created in the external CalDAV calendar first
(synchronous write-through, P9-S4): 409 external_conflict, 502 caldav_write_failed,
503 caldav_disabled/crypto_unconfigured on remote/composition failures.

patch.description:
A mirrored event is written through to the external server first (GET-modify-PUT under
the fresh remote ETag, P9-S4) — the local change applies only after the remote accepted.

delete.description: A mirrored event is deleted on the external server first (If-Match, P9-S4).

post.description:
Cancel a single occurrence of a recurring series (owner-only). 422 if the event is not a
series or the date is not one of its occurrences.
Undo a cancellation — re-add a previously cancelled occurrence to the series (owner-only).

Move a single occurrence of a series to a new time (owner-only). 422 if the date is not one
of its occurrences, is cancelled, or the new range is inverted.
Undo a move — return a moved occurrence to its rule time (owner-only).

Import an uploaded iCalendar file (raw text — no URL fetch, so no SSRF). Events land in the
chosen layer, owned by the caller; re-importing the same file is idempotent (UID dedup).
Create or **rotate** the caller's secret ICS subscription URL (any old link is revoked).

get.description: The caller's external CalDAV subscriptions (only their own — never a co-member's).

schema.title: Response List Subscriptions V1 Calendar Subscriptions Get

post.description:
Subscribe to an external CalDAV collection. With credentials the server crypto key is
required (503 without one, ADR-0077); 409 on a duplicate URL.

patch.description:
Patch a subscription under If-Match; new credentials replace the stored ones,
``clear_credentials`` drops them.

delete.description: Unsubscribe (soft-delete; the same URL can be re-subscribed afterwards).

post.description:
Probe the stored URL + credentials once and answer immediately.

Without it the only feedback on a wrong URL or password is ``last_sync_error`` after the next
15-minute cron tick. A pure probe: nothing is written, no mirror is touched. A failure is
answered as data (``ok=false`` + category), not raised — a typo is an expected outcome, not a
server fault.

The household's weather: its location (if set) and the current forecast (empty on the base

place instead of typing raw lat/lon. Empty when weather is off / upstream down (graceful).

Suggest up to ``limit`` conflict-free slots of ``duration_min`` minutes within the window
(defaults: now .. now+7 days) and the daily working hours ``[day_start, day_end]`` (UTC).

schema.title: Response Suggest Slots V1 Scheduling Slots Get

get.description: The plan for the week containing ``week_start`` (default: this week). Created on demand.

put.description: Set one slot of the given week (recipe or free text, plus cook/note).

delete.description: Clear one slot of the given week.

post.description:
Mark the recipe in a slot as cooked → feeds the recipe's „zuletzt gekocht"-Historie. 422 if
the slot has no recipe.

get.description:
Suggest one recipe **to the caller** without touching the shared week plan.

``POST /suggest`` looks like a suggestion but writes (``set_slot`` + ``mealplan.updated``).
This one is read-only, which is precisely why the caller's own wearable recovery signal may
shape it: the member decides, and only their explicit ``PUT /slot`` changes anything shared
(S-14 "nur für eigene Vorschläge", ADR-0081 §9). 404 when nothing qualifies.

post.description:
Auto-fill one slot with the least-recently-cooked eligible recipe („neu würfeln", ADR-0052).
Skips recipes cooked within ``lockout_days`` and those already planned this week. 422 if none
qualifies. Returns the refreshed week (like ``PUT /slot``).

Fill every empty cell of one meal across the week with distinct recipes. Without
``target_kcal``: least-recently-cooked („Woche würfeln", ADR-0052). With ``target_kcal``: the
recipes whose per-portion kcal is closest to the goal (P6-S12, ADR-0057). ``exclude_tag``
(repeatable) drops recipes with that tag (allergens/diet, P6-S13). Best-effort — an empty pool
fills nothing (no 422); existing entries are never overwritten.

Copy a plan into ``week_start``'s **empty** cells from ``source_week`` (default: the previous
week). Non-destructive — existing target entries stay; returns the refreshed target week.

Create a personal cooking task „Kochen: <Gericht>" from a slot (Synergie S-03, ADR-0053).
Assigned to the slot's cook or the caller. 422 if the slot has no dish.

Create an advance-prep task „Vorbereiten: <Gericht>" if the slot's recipe needs lead time
(Synergie S-02, ADR-0055). 422 if the slot has no recipe or nothing to prepare ahead.

get.description:
Summed per-portion macros of the week's planned recipes (P6-S10) — a step toward the
nutrition-goal automation. Free-text slots are ignored; ``confidence`` flags estimates. With
``target_kcal`` the per-portion average is graded ±10% (P6-S11): under/on_target/over.

post.description:
Add the week's recipe ingredients to the default shopping list (KONZEPT §5.5). Idempotent —
re-running upserts the same items, so it never duplicates.

get.description: The household's notes (pinned first). ``?pinned=true`` returns only the pinned ones.

AttachmentResponse.title: AttachmentResponse
AttachmentResponse.description:
Metadata of a guide attachment. The bytes live in blob storage and are fetched separately
(``GET …/attachments/{id}``); the response never carries them.

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description:
One append-only ``audit_log`` record for the operator audit view (ADR-0073). The log is
**PII-free by construction** — ``detail`` carries only structured, content-free context (query
lengths, counts, keys). Read-only; the console never mutates the trail.

AuthorizeRequest.title: AuthorizeRequest
AuthorizeRequest.description:
Start the OAuth flow for the chosen data types (Art. 9: consent per type, KONZEPT §5.15).

At least one type is required: a connection without any consented type would collect nothing
and have no legal basis to exist.

AuthorizeResponse.title: AuthorizeResponse
AuthorizeResponse.description:
Where to send the browser. The state token is embedded in the URL and deliberately not
exposed as a separate field — nothing client-side needs it.

AutoAcceptRuleCreate.title: AutoAcceptRuleCreate
AutoAcceptRuleCreate.description: A standing rule: auto-accept listings of ``template_id`` (or any) up to ``max_price``.

BalanceResponse.title: BalanceResponse
BalanceResponse.description: A member's current points balance (a SUM over the ledger, never a stored field).

BannerResponse.title: BannerResponse
BannerResponse.description: A global banner (ops list / app display).

CaptureCreate.title: CaptureCreate
CaptureCreate.description: A free-text Zuruf. The server parses it; the client never sends a pre-parsed proposal.

ChallengeResponse.title: ChallengeResponse
ChallengeResponse.description:
Weekly challenge standings (points earned from task completions this ISO week), highest
first, computed live from the ledger. ``thanks_remaining`` = caller's remaining weekly cap.

CommentCreate.title: CommentCreate
CommentCreate.description: Post a comment on an object (``object_type`` + ``object_id``).

CommentResponse.title: CommentResponse
CommentResponse.description:
One comment on an object, oldest-first in the thread. ``version`` is the ETag for editing —
the thread carries it so the client can PATCH inline (If-Match) without a per-comment GET.

CommentUpdate.title: CommentUpdate
CommentUpdate.description: Edit a comment's body (author only, PATCH + If-Match). Only ``body_md`` is mutable.

ConnectionResponse.title: ConnectionResponse
ConnectionResponse.description:
One wearable connection. ``has_tokens`` stands in for the credentials; the tokens
themselves never leave the server.

ConsentUpdate.title: ConsentUpdate
ConsentUpdate.description:
Replace the consented types of an existing connection.

Empty list is allowed and meaningful: it withdraws everything, which disconnects (a
connection without consent must not survive). Types dropped here have their stored values
erased immediately.

CookTaskResult.title: CookTaskResult
CookTaskResult.description: The personal cooking task created from a slot (Synergie S-03, ADR-0053).

CorrectionRequest.title: CorrectionRequest
CorrectionRequest.description: Admin grant (amount > 0) or claw-back (amount < 0) of points for a member.

DeletionBlockerResponse.title: DeletionBlockerResponse
DeletionBlockerResponse.description:
Ein Haushalt, der die Kontolöschung aufhält. ``reason`` ist ein stabiler Slug, den die
Oberfläche in einen Satz übersetzt — nie ein fertiger Text vom Server.

DiagnosticEntry.title: DiagnosticEntry
DiagnosticEntry.description:
One technical breadcrumb from the client ring buffer. **No content/PII** — only the route
the user was on, the error-reference short-code (ARCHITECTURE §12) and the HTTP status.

DigestSetting.title: DigestSetting
DigestSetting.description: Whether the weekly digest is enabled for the household (P8-S6/S7b).

DissolveHouseholdRequest.title: DissolveHouseholdRequest
DissolveHouseholdRequest.description:
Der Haushaltsname, abgetippt.

Kein `window.confirm`: das ist die schärfste irreversible Aktion der Anwendung. Ein Wert, den
ein Angreifer nicht kennt, macht sie gegen Clickjacking-Restrisiken unbrauchbar — und zwingt
die Person, einen Moment innezuhalten (ADR-0085).

DissolvePreview.title: DissolvePreview
DissolvePreview.description: Was die Auflösung kosten wird — vor dem Knopf, nicht als Fehler danach.

EnvelopeResponse.title: EnvelopeResponse
EnvelopeResponse.description: A wrapped household-key envelope (opaque to the server).

EnvelopeUpsert.title: EnvelopeUpsert
EnvelopeUpsert.description:
Store a wrapped household-key envelope. ``passphrase`` binds to the current member and may be
replaced; ``recovery`` is household-wide (member_id NULL) and write-once. The server sets
``member_id`` itself.

EventResponse.title: EventResponse
EventResponse.description:
One event or one expanded occurrence. For a recurring series, ``id``/``series_id`` are the
master id and ``starts_at``/``ends_at`` are the concrete occurrence; ``recurring`` is true and
``rrule`` carries the series rule. Editing/deleting by ``id`` affects the whole series;
``exdates`` are the cancelled single occurrences (P5-S5).

EventUpdate.title: EventUpdate
EventUpdate.description: All fields optional (partial update under If-Match). A null field is left unchanged.

FairnessResponse.title: FairnessResponse
FairnessResponse.description:
Fairness account (KONZEPT §5.9): each member's load over the rolling window, lowest first
(least carried = next in line). Computed live from the ledger; absence-exclusion = Phase 5.

FeedResponse.title: FeedResponse
FeedResponse.description: The caller's secret ICS subscription URL (paste into Google/Nextcloud/Apple Calendar).

FeedbackCreate.title: FeedbackCreate
FeedbackCreate.description:
Submit feedback: a category plus a free-text message, optionally tagged with the
error-reference short-code the user saw, the route they were on, and an opt-in diagnostics
attachment (technical breadcrumbs only, never content).

FeedbackDiagnostics.title: FeedbackDiagnostics
FeedbackDiagnostics.description:
Strictly opt-in diagnostics attachment (KONZEPT §5.12): app version + a bounded ring buffer
of recent error breadcrumbs. Bounded length keeps the payload small and carries **no** message
content. ``extra="forbid"`` so a client cannot smuggle arbitrary data through.

FeedbackResponse.title: FeedbackResponse
FeedbackResponse.description: One feedback submission (the caller's own, newest first).

FlagSet.title: FlagSet
FlagSet.description: Set (or change) a global flag override.

FollowUp.title: FollowUp
FollowUp.description:
An action-chain follow-up task (KONZEPT §5.17 Deo-Fall): when the primary is a shopping item,
a ``dann …``/``then …`` clause becomes a task armed on that item being checked.

Forecast.title: Forecast
Forecast.description:
A parsed forecast. ``current`` may be absent if the provider omits it; ``daily`` is the
per-day outlook. Also the Redis cache payload.

GenerateResult.title: GenerateResult
GenerateResult.description: How many distinct shopping items the week's recipes added to the default list (S-?? §5.5).

GeocodeResult.title: GeocodeResult
GeocodeResult.description:
One place candidate from a name search (Open-Meteo geocoding). The web picks one to set the
household location, so the user never types raw coordinates.

GuideCreate.title: GuideCreate
GuideCreate.description: Create a guide: a title plus optional markdown body, category, tags and a contact member.

GuideSummary.title: GuideSummary
GuideSummary.description: List item: no body (kept light for the list/search view).

GuideUpdate.title: GuideUpdate
GuideUpdate.description:
Patch a guide (PATCH + If-Match). All fields optional; only the present ones change. Sending
``contact_id: null`` clears the contact (presence is read via ``model_fields_set``).

HouseholdMetadata.title: HouseholdMetadata
HouseholdMetadata.description:
Org-level household metadata for support search (aggregate view ``household_metadata``):
name, age, member counts. **No** household content (recipes/tasks/messages), per ADR-0015.

IcsImportRequest.title: IcsImportRequest
IcsImportRequest.description:
Raw iCalendar text to import (uploaded file content — no URL fetch, so no SSRF). Imported
events land in ``layer`` and are owned by the caller. ``content`` is size-capped.

IcsImportResult.title: IcsImportResult
IcsImportResult.description:
Outcome of an import: how many VEVENTs were created, skipped as already-imported duplicates
(same UID in the household), or failed (e.g. an invalid RRULE).

LetterCreate.title: LetterCreate
LetterCreate.description: Write a letter. ``to_ids`` empty = a round-letter to the whole household.

LetterResponse.title: LetterResponse
LetterResponse.description: A full letter incl. body. Fetching it marks it read for the viewer (if a recipient).

LetterSummary.title: LetterSummary
LetterSummary.description:
Inbox list item: no body. ``read_by_me`` reflects the viewer; ``read_count`` is how many
distinct members have opened it.

LetterToTaskResult.title: LetterToTaskResult
LetterToTaskResult.description: The personal task created from a letter („Kümmerst du dich?", P7-S5, ADR-0063).

LinkCreate.title: LinkCreate
LinkCreate.description:
Link two objects. Order is irrelevant — the endpoints are canonicalised server-side, so
``(a, b)`` and ``(b, a)`` reference the same link.

LinkResponse.title: LinkResponse
LinkResponse.description: One link between two objects (endpoints in canonical order).

ListingCreate.title: ListingCreate
ListingCreate.description: List one of your own open task instances for sale at ``price`` points.

LocationIn.title: LocationIn
LocationIn.description: Set the household's coarse weather location. Bounds are validated; the UI rounds first.

LoginEventResponse.title: LoginEventResponse
LoginEventResponse.description: A past login attempt (security activity view). PII-free: country code only.

MealSlotResponse.title: MealSlotResponse
MealSlotResponse.description:
One filled slot. ``recipe_title`` is resolved via recipes.api (null if the recipe was since
deleted or the slot is free text).

NoteCreate.title: NoteCreate
NoteCreate.description: Create a note: a title plus optional markdown body; ``pinned`` defaults off.

NoteSummary.title: NoteSummary
NoteSummary.description: List item: no body (kept light for the list view).

NoteUpdate.title: NoteUpdate
NoteUpdate.description: Patch a note (PATCH + If-Match). All fields optional; only the present ones change.

NoteVersionResponse.title: NoteVersionResponse
NoteVersionResponse.description: An archived previous version of a note (P7-S2, newest first; max 5 kept).

NutritionOut.title: NutritionOut
NutritionOut.description:
Per-portion nutrition for a recipe (computed via nutrition.api; S5). ``confidence`` is
``"complete"`` only if every line was counted, else ``"estimated"``; ``covered``/``total`` =
how many lines contributed.

OccurrenceMove.title: OccurrenceMove
OccurrenceMove.description: Move one occurrence (identified by ``occurrence_start``) to a new time (P5-S10).

OccurrenceRef.title: OccurrenceRef
OccurrenceRef.description: Identifies one occurrence of a series by its original start instant (RFC-5545 EXDATE key).

OperatorLogin.title: OperatorLogin
OperatorLogin.description: Operator login: e-mail + password + mandatory TOTP code (ADR-0015).

OperatorPasskeySummary.title: OperatorPasskeySummary
OperatorPasskeySummary.description: A registered operator passkey for the management list (no secret material).

OperatorSession.title: OperatorSession
OperatorSession.description: Opaque operator-session bearer token (send as ``Authorization: Bearer <token>``).

OperatorSummary.title: OperatorSummary
OperatorSummary.description: One operator for the management list. NEVER exposes password_hash/totp_secret.

OpsFeedbackEntry.title: OpsFeedbackEntry
OpsFeedbackEntry.description:
A feedback submission as seen in the operator inbox (view ``ops_feedback``). Feedback is a
channel addressed to support, so the message is visible here. ``diagnostics`` is the opt-in
technical breadcrumb attachment the user chose to include (app version + recent error refs;
no content), or null.

OpsFlags.title: OpsFlags
OpsFlags.description:
Operator-set global flag overrides + the set of flaggable keys (so the console can render
every togglable flag, including those without an override yet).

OpsHealth.title: OpsHealth
OpsHealth.description: Build/health info for the ops console (§12). Operator-only.

OpsKpis.title: OpsKpis
OpsKpis.description: The ops dashboard payload: global counters + the signup curve (newest day first).

OpsPasskeyLoginOptions.title: OpsPasskeyLoginOptions
OpsPasskeyLoginOptions.description: Passwordless-login options + the cookieless flow handle to echo back on complete.

ParsedProposal.title: ParsedProposal
ParsedProposal.description:
The deterministic parser's result — what the Zuruf is understood to mean. ``target=none`` is
an „Unsortiert"-capture (no buy verb, no forcing hint) that needs manual triage.

PasskeyOptions.title: PasskeyOptions
PasskeyOptions.description: WebAuthn ceremony options (passed verbatim to the browser ``navigator.credentials``).

PersonalSuggestionResponse.title: PersonalSuggestionResponse
PersonalSuggestionResponse.description:
A recipe proposed TO the caller — never written to the shared week plan.

``reasons`` are machine-readable codes the web translates (mirroring the scheduling engine).
Because this endpoint writes nothing, the caller's own recovery signal may shape it without a
health state ever determining a household record (ADR-0081 §9).

PrepTaskResult.title: PrepTaskResult
PrepTaskResult.description:
The advance-prep task created from a slot (Synergie S-02, ADR-0055). ``hint`` is the matched
lead-time cue (e.g. ``"marinieren"``) that triggered it.

ProfileResponse.title: ProfileResponse
ProfileResponse.description: Self-service profile; ``version`` is the ETag (If-Match optimistic concurrency).

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
Partial profile update — only the provided fields change. ``display_name``/``locale`` are
columns; the rest live in ``users.settings_json``.

RecipeImportResponse.title: RecipeImportResponse
RecipeImportResponse.description:
A review-before-save draft extracted from a URL (KONZEPT §5.2). Same shape the editor
pre-fills; the user confirms/corrects, then saves via ``POST /v1/recipes``. Not persisted.

RecipeResponse.title: RecipeResponse
RecipeResponse.description: Full recipe; ``version`` is the ETag for If-Match optimistic concurrency.

RecipeUpdate.title: RecipeUpdate
RecipeUpdate.description: Partial update (If-Match). ``ingredients``, if provided, replaces the whole list.

RewardResponse.title: RewardResponse
RewardResponse.description: A reward; ``version`` is the ETag for admin If-Match.

RoomHeatmapEntry.title: RoomHeatmapEntry
RoomHeatmapEntry.description:
A room's computed freshness for the heatmap (KONZEPT §5.9): status from last completion +
``decay_days``; never stored.

ServerEntityState.title: ServerEntityState
ServerEntityState.description: Authoritative state after applying; the client overwrites its local copy with this.

SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse
SessionResponse.description:
Lightweight session view returned by register/login/refresh and household
switches. The cookies carry the real payload; this just tells the client who it
is and which household is active (``None`` right after registration).

SessionView.title: SessionView
SessionView.description:
One active login/device (a refresh rotation family). ``current`` marks the session
behind the present access token, so the UI can label it and warn before self-logout.

SlotResponse.title: SlotResponse
SlotResponse.description:
One suggested free slot. ``reasons`` are machine-readable codes (e.g. ``no_conflict``,
``within_work_hours``) the web maps to localised plain-text justification (KONZEPT §5.12).

SlotSet.title: SlotSet
SlotSet.description:
Set one slot of the week. A slot is a recipe **or** free text (not both); both null clears
the content but may still carry a cook/note. ``cook_id`` is who cooks (optional).

SubscriptionCheckResponse.title: SubscriptionCheckResponse
SubscriptionCheckResponse.description:
Outcome of a connection probe (P9). ``category`` reuses the ``last_sync_error`` slug family
so the web renders it with the same message map; ``objects`` is a plain count (never titles or
content) so a successful check can say "reachable, 42 entries" without leaking a calendar.

SubscriptionCreate.title: SubscriptionCreate
SubscriptionCreate.description:
Subscribe to an external CalDAV collection (P9-S2). ``username``/``password`` are optional
(public collections work anonymously) but only valid together — they are encrypted server-side
(ADR-0077) and never returned.

SubscriptionResponse.title: SubscriptionResponse
SubscriptionResponse.description:
One CalDAV subscription — write-only credentials: the wire shape carries only
``has_credentials``, never username/password/ciphertext. ``last_sync_at`` stays null until the
9-S3 pull-sync stamps it.

SubscriptionUpdate.title: SubscriptionUpdate
SubscriptionUpdate.description:
Partial update under If-Match. A null field is left unchanged; ``username``+``password``
together replace the stored credentials; ``clear_credentials`` drops them (422 combined with
new credentials).

SyncChange.title: SyncChange
SyncChange.description: One delta-pull change: an upsert (current fields) or a delete (tombstone, empty fields).

SyncOp.title: SyncOp
SyncOp.description:
One offline operation. ``fields`` carries only the changed fields (per-field-group LWW);
``base_version`` is informational (LWW resolves conflicts, it never rejects).

TaskInstanceCreate.title: TaskInstanceCreate
TaskInstanceCreate.description:
Create an instance from a template (``template_id`` set -> title/points snapshotted) OR
ad-hoc (``template_id`` null -> ``title`` required).

TaskInstanceResponse.title: TaskInstanceResponse
TaskInstanceResponse.description: A task instance; ``version`` is the ETag for the complete action's If-Match.

TaskTemplateResponse.title: TaskTemplateResponse
TaskTemplateResponse.description: A task template; ``version`` is the ETag for If-Match optimistic concurrency.

ThanksRequest.title: ThanksRequest
ThanksRequest.description: Send thank-you points to another member (KONZEPT §5.9).

ToTaskResult.title: ToTaskResult
ToTaskResult.description: The personal task created from a note („Konvertieren-zu", P7-S3, ADR-0061).

TrashedNote.title: TrashedNote
TrashedNote.description:
A soft-deleted note in the trash (P8-S4). ``deleted_at`` lets the UI show how long it has
left before the retention reaper purges it for good (30-day window, P8-S3).

UnreadCount.title: UnreadCount
UnreadCount.description: How many letters addressed to the viewer are still unread.

UsageCounters.title: UsageCounters
UsageCounters.description: Global counters (aggregate view ``usage_counters``) — no per-household detail.

VaultItemCreate.title: VaultItemCreate
VaultItemCreate.description: Store an encrypted secret. ``ciphertext`` + ``item_meta`` are produced client-side.

VaultItemResponse.title: VaultItemResponse
VaultItemResponse.description: A full encrypted secret incl. its ``ciphertext``.

VaultItemSummary.title: VaultItemSummary
VaultItemSummary.description:
List item: the encrypted name lives in ``item_meta`` — the secret ``ciphertext`` is **not**
shipped on list load (fetch the full item to decrypt its body).

VaultItemUpdate.title: VaultItemUpdate
VaultItemUpdate.description: Patch an encrypted secret (PATCH + If-Match). Only present fields change.

WeatherResponse.title: WeatherResponse
WeatherResponse.description:
The household weather view. ``configured`` is false when no location is set; ``forecast`` is
null when no location is set, the provider is the null adapter, or the upstream call failed —
every one a graceful base path, not an error.

WeekNutrition.title: WeekNutrition
WeekNutrition.description:
Summed per-portion macros of the week's planned recipes (P6-S10). ``meals_counted`` = how
many recipe-slots contributed; ``confidence`` is ``estimated`` if any recipe lacked data.

WeekResponse.title: WeekResponse
WeekResponse.description:
A week's plan: its Monday plus every filled slot (empty slots are simply absent).
``absent_days`` = weekday indices (0-6) the viewer is away (Synergie S-01, ADR-0054); only the
read endpoint fills it (writes return ``[]`` — the web refetches the week after a mutation).
